entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE
entities.description: Substate where UE camps on a suitable/acceptable cell but initiates no 5GMM signalling and ignores paging requests.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-SUPI
entities.description: Substate entered when USIM is removed from the UE.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
entities.description: Substate entered when UE loses coverage.

entities.name: 5GMM-NULL
entities.description: State entered when UE is deactivated (e.g., powered off).

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION
entities.description: Substate entered when UE receives request to establish eCall over IMS or non-emergency call.

entities.name: USIM removed
entities.description: Condition triggered when USIM is removed from the UE.

entities.name: Coverage lost
entities.description: Condition triggered when UE loses network coverage.

entities.name: UE deactivated
entities.description: Condition triggered when UE is powered off or deactivated by user.

entities.name: eCall over IMS request
entities.description: Condition triggered when upper layers request establishment of eCall over IMS.

entities.name: Non-emergency call request
entities.description: Condition triggered when upper layers request call to HPLMN designated non-emergency MSISDN/URI.

entities.name: No 5GMM signalling
entities.description: UE behavior in eCALL-INACTIVE state where no 5GMM signalling is initiated with network.

entities.name: Ignore paging requests
entities.description: UE behavior in eCALL-INACTIVE state where paging requests are ignored.

relations.description: eCALL-INACTIVE state establishes no 5GMM signalling behavior.
eCALL-INACTIVE state establishes paging ignore behavior.
USIM removal condition establishes transition to NO-SUPI state.
Coverage loss condition establishes transition to PLMN-SEARCH state.
UE deactivation condition establishes transition to NULL state.
eCall over IMS request condition establishes transition to ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION state.
Non-emergency call request condition establishes transition to ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION state.
